name: Akapulu Labs
description: Akapulu Labs is an AI research lab building live conversational avatars.

instructions: Akapulu Labs builds live AI avatars on real-time calls. Two shapes: (1) a hosted link — public page Akapulu Labs hosts; open URL, Start Call; page never sees the API key; (2) your voice pipeline (speech-to-speech or any stack that produces assistant audio) plus Akapulu Labs avatar video in a Daily room you create. Calls use conversation minutes (akapulu.com/pricing). For agent onboarding (skills, MCP, account, which path to take), follow https://docs.akapulu.com/agent-setup.md.

Hosted links: create in the dashboard or Bearer CRUD on /api/hosted-links/ (GET/POST/DELETE collection; GET/PUT/DELETE by id). Create body is exactly label, avatar_id, system_prompt, show_ai_label. Response includes url and token.

Plugin path: Akapulu Labs uses Daily. On a new room, create_akapulu_call from pipecat-akapulu runs on their server. It reads DAILY_API_KEY and AKAPULU_API_KEY, creates a private Daily room, mints the three meeting tokens (browser, voice bot, Akapulu Labs worker), and POST /api/live-sessions/. It returns the room URL, the bot token, the browser token, and session_id. The room lasts two hours unless they pass room_exp_secs. A bot that already has a Daily room mints the worker token and POSTs avatar_id, show_ai_label, room_url, and avatar_token itself. That POST starts the Akapulu Labs worker and returns session_id. The code is on Your bot. AkapuluAvatar (pipecat-akapulu) runs inside the voice bot after assistant audio and sends that audio to the Akapulu Labs worker. The worker joins the call as a Daily participant and publishes the audio and the video, so voice-bot audio/video out stay off. The voice bot unsubscribes from the Avatar microphone when that participant joins. The browser stays subscribed to it. Public example akapulu-examples uses Deepgram Flux (`flux-general-multi`), OpenAI `gpt-5.4-mini`, and Cartesia Sonic 3.6.
Every avatar frame has an invisible mark; verify with POST /api/video-marks/ then POST /api/video-marks/<id>/read/. API errors include error_code — branch on that field, not the English string.
